title: 第三章 地下室生存法则：先布一百个陷阱-《无CP废土：基建养出全》
content:
第(1/3)页

    一、短暂的信任

    黑暗里，那脚步声停了。

    不是停在入口，是停在了挡板外侧——那人被铁丝网绊了一下，碎石簌簌滑落，空罐头盒在头顶钢筋上晃出轻响。

    林霜没动。

    右手石斧横在膝前，左手匕首反握，刀尖贴着小臂内侧。她闭着眼，呼吸压得极长、极轻，像一块嵌进墙角的石头。

    挡板被轻轻推了一下。

    铁丝绷紧，羊角锤在砖缝里发出微不可察的摩擦声。那人似乎察觉到里面有布置，动作顿住。

    然后，一个沙哑的女声，压得极低，像怕惊动外面的什么东西：

    “……里面有人吗？“

    没回答。

    “我不是掠夺者。“那声音带着颤，却强撑着平稳，“我……我从医疗帐篷逃出来的，后面有人在追。求你，让我躲一晚，天亮我就走。“

    林霜睁开眼。

    系统面板在视野边缘无声刷新：【热源：1，体型匹配成年女性，体温偏低，心跳过速，无金属武器反应。】

    她沉默了三秒。

    三秒里，外面远处传来引擎熄火的声响，男人的咒骂，手电筒光柱扫过废墟的晃影。追兵在附近，但没发现这个入口。

    林霜用钢管轻轻敲了一下地面——两短一长。

    挡板外的人僵住了，没懂。

    “掀开挡板，爬进来。“林霜声音压得比她还低，“动作慢，别碰铁丝。敢拿武器，我砍你手。“

    一阵窸窣。

    挡板被从外侧缓缓抬高一角，灰白微光漏进来，照见一张脸：年轻，苍白，短发被血和泥糊成绺，左眼肿得只剩一条缝。她拖着左腿，用右肘撑地，像条脱水的鱼一样往里蹭。

    林霜盯着她左腿不自然的角度——骨裂，或者更糟。

    等人完全进来，林霜一脚蹬回挡板，铁丝复位，罐头盒悬回原处。整套动作没发出半点多余声响。

    那人瘫在墙角，胸口剧烈起伏，却死死咬住嘴唇，把喘息声咽回去。

    有点意思。知道疼不叫，知道怕不哭。

    林霜没放松警惕，石斧始终在手边，只把打火机打亮一瞬，照了照对方的脸和双手——空着，没武器。

    “名字。“

    “……苏琳。“

    “为什么被追。“

    苏琳的喉结动了动，像是那三个字烫嘴：“掠夺者。铁锤帮。他们抓女人……“她没说完，但林霜懂了。

    系统提示适时弹出：【检测到目标左臂静脉留置针痕迹，近期被强制输液/注射。结合陈述，可信度：中高。】

    林霜从背包侧兜掏出那个军绿水壶，晃了晃，递过去。

    “两口。多一滴没有。“

    苏琳捧着水壶的手还在抖，却强迫自己小口慢咽。每咽一口，眼睛就飞快扫一圈地下室，最后停在林霜握石斧的右手上——那只手很稳，指节上有茧，不是普通幸存者。

    林霜也在审视她。

    苏琳靠在墙边喘气的功夫，她在脑海里过了一遍观察结果：年轻女性，二十出头，左手背有静脉留置针痕迹，左腿拖地不自然，可能骨裂。呼吸急促，瞳孔对光反射正常，意识清醒。没有武器，没有攻击意图。

    “系统，基础扫描。“

    “扫描完毕。热源：1，体型匹配成年女性，体温35.8℃（偏低），心跳112次/分（过速），无金属武器反应，无剧烈敌意激素波动。威胁评估：无。“

    林霜不需要系统提醒……

    “系统，可信度中高代表什么？“

    “威胁低于5%。但饿极了人会变，建议留着心眼。“

    林霜不需要系统提醒。她见过太多——废墟里为半瓶水翻脸的同伴，救援时被救者反过来抢她背包。信任是奢侈品，她现在连一瓶净水都舍不得浪费。

    “你说自己是医学生。“林霜语气平直，不带丝毫情绪起伏，“哪所学校？就读几年？有无临床实操经验？“

    苏琳放下水壶，抬手用袖口擦去嘴角水渍，涣散的眼神慢慢聚拢，像是在打捞一段遥远的旧时光。

    “同济医大，2030年入学，五年制。2035年战争爆发时，正好大四下学期，还差三个月毕业。“

    她声音低沉，带着一丝沧桑，“学校被炸后，跟着同学逃进废墟漂泊三年。日常清创、伤口缝合、骨折固定都做过，常见感染、腹泻、轻度辐射病，也经手过不少幸存者病例。“

    “有执业证书吗？“

    苏琳愣了愣，随即露出一抹苦涩的笑：“废土乱世，一纸证书还有意义吗？“

    “证书是旧世界的背书，我要的是新世界的本事。“

    林霜右手石斧横在膝前不动，左手从腰侧抽出断尖匕首，刀刃朝内，将刀柄递向苏琳。

    “帮我看看左臂伤口。敢转刀刃，我砍你手腕。“诊断精准、处理方案合理，你可以留下。若是滥竽充数，天亮自行离开。“

    苏琳盯着刀刃，瞳孔微缩，却没有后退躲闪。

    “你根本没想过杀我。“她语气忽然笃定，“若要动手，方才我毫无防备喝水时，你早已下手。“

    “帮我看看左臂伤口。“林霜淡淡开口，“诊断精准、处理方案合理，你可以留下。若是滥竽充数，天亮自行离开。“

    苏琳接过匕首，下意识在卫衣下摆蹭了蹭指尖——那里沾着入口处的铁锈和碎石屑。

    这个细微举动，让林霜心底暗自点头。不是擦得多干净，是擦这个动作本身——说明她知道碰伤口前手要净，哪怕条件所限只能凑合。有这根弦，就不是野路子。

    “我看看伤口。“

    林霜缓缓解开缠绕左臂的布条。

    地下室昏暗无光，只有入口缝隙漏进一缕灰白微光。苏琳凑近身子，指尖轻轻按压伤口周遭红肿皮肉，低头轻嗅气味，眉头骤然拧紧。

    苏琳凑近身子，指尖轻轻按压伤口周遭红肿皮肉，低头轻嗅气味，眉头骤然拧紧。

    “你处理过？肥皂水清洗，还刮了坏死组织？“

    林霜点头。

    “处理得对，但不够。“苏琳指着伤口边缘一圈暗红，“坏死组织没刮净，脓腔没打开，细菌在深层繁殖。再拖二十四小时，感染入血，神仙难救。我现在要重新清创，你忍得住吗？“

    “你有抗生素？“

    苏琳轻轻摇头：“连夜逃亡，什么都没来得及带出。但被押送途中，我装昏偷瞄过一眼——医疗帐篷门口两个守卫，换班时听过他们报时。帐篷里有药箱，绿色十字标，堆在进门左手边。“

    “你想让我硬闯掠夺者营地？“

    “不是现在。“苏琳摇头，“等你的伤口稳住，我们攒够武器、摸清地形，再伺机动手。“

    两人彼此对视，无声试探。

    苏琳试探林霜是否值得托付依附，林霜试探她究竟是真有本事，还是空有口头说辞。

    “三条规则，现在立。“林霜拿回匕首，别回腰侧，“第一，听我调度；第二，物资统管；第三，背叛者逐出。同意就留下，不同意现在走。“

    “我答应。“

    “物资统管，任何人不得私藏公物。未分配前，尽数公用。私人物品——照片、信物——自己收好，不占公用份额。“

    “可以。“

    “日后若有新人加入，规则同样适用。一旦有人背叛，由我亲自处理。“

    苏琳沉默一瞬，轻声问：“你说的处理……是什么方式？“

    林霜没有回话，握着石斧的拇指，轻轻慢拍两下斧柄。

    无声的动作，透着冰冷的决绝。

    苏琳瞬间了然，再不敢多问半句。

1. Short-lived trust

In the darkness, the footsteps stopped.

He didn't stop at the entrance, but outside the barrier - the man tripped over the barbed wire fence, the gravel slid down, and the empty can made a soft sound on the steel bars above his head.

Lin Shuang didn’t move.

The stone ax in the right hand is placed in front of the knee, and the dagger in the left hand is held backward, with the tip of the knife against the inside of the forearm.She closed her eyes and breathed very long and lightly, like a stone embedded in the corner of the wall.

The bezel was pushed slightly.

The wire was taut, and the claw hammer made an imperceptible friction sound in the cracks of the bricks.The man seemed to be aware of the arrangement inside and paused.

Then, a hoarse female voice spoke in an extremely low voice, as if she was afraid of disturbing something outside:

“…Is there anyone inside?”

No answer.

"I'm not a predator." The voice was trembling, but he managed to stay steady, "I...I escaped from the medical tent, and someone was chasing me. Please, let me hide for one night, and I'll leave at dawn."

Lin Shuang opened his eyes.

The system panel refreshed silently at the edge of the field of view: [Heat source: 1, body shape matches an adult female, low body temperature, tachycardia, no reaction to metal weapons.】

She was silent for three seconds.

Within three seconds, there was the sound of an engine stalling in the distance outside, a man cursing, and the flashlight beam sweeping across the ruins.Pursuers were nearby but had not discovered the entrance.

Lin Shuang tapped the ground with a steel pipe - two short and one long.

The people outside the barrier froze, not understanding.

"Open the baffle and climb in." Lin Shuang's voice was lower than hers, "Move slowly and don't touch the wire. If you dare to use a weapon, I will cut off your hand."

There was a rustling.

The baffle was slowly raised from the outside, and a grayish-white light leaked in, revealing a face: young and pale, with short hair covered in blood and mud, and the left eye was so swollen that there was only a slit left.She dragged her left leg, put her right elbow on the ground, and rubbed it in like a dehydrated fish.

Lin Shuang stared at the unnatural angle of her left leg—a broken bone, or worse.

When everyone came in completely, Lin Shuang kicked back the baffle, reset the iron wire, and hung the can back to its original place.The whole set of movements did not make any unnecessary noise.

The man slumped in the corner, his chest heaving violently, but he bit his lips to swallow back his gasp.

It’s a bit interesting.Know the pain but don't scream, know the fear but don't cry.

Lin Shuang did not let down his guard. The stone ax was always at hand. He only turned on the lighter for a moment and shined a light on the opponent's face and hands - they were empty and without weapons.

“Name.”

"...Su Lin."

"Why are you being chased?"

Su Lin's Adam's apple moved, as if those three words were hot on her tongue: "Predators. Hammer Gang. They arrest women..." She didn't finish her sentence, but Lin Shuang understood.

The system prompt pops up at the right time: [Traces of an indwelling needle in the vein of the target's left arm were detected, and he was recently forced to infuse/inject.Combined statement, credibility: medium to high.】

Lin Shuang took out the army green water bottle from the side pocket of his backpack, shook it, and handed it over.

"Two mouthfuls. Not a drop more."

Su Lin’s hand holding the kettle was still shaking, but she forced herself to swallow slowly.Every time he swallowed, his eyes quickly scanned around the basement, and finally stopped on Lin Shuang's right hand holding the stone ax - that hand was very stable, with calluses on the knuckles, not an ordinary survivor.

Lin Shuang was also examining her.

While Su Lin was leaning against the wall and panting, she went through the observation results in her mind: young woman, in her early twenties, with traces of intravenous needles on the back of her left hand, her left leg dragging unnaturally on the floor, and possibly a bone fracture.Shortness of breath, normal pupillary light reflex, and clear consciousness.No weapons, no intent to attack.

"System, basic scan."

"Scan completed. Heat source: 1, body shape matches an adult female, body temperature 35.8°C (low), heartbeat 112 beats/min (fast), no metal weapon reaction, no severe hostile hormone fluctuations. Threat assessment: None. "

Lin Shuang does not need system reminder...

"System, what does medium to high reliability mean?"

"The threat is less than 5%. But people will change when they are very hungry, so it is recommended to keep an eye out. "

Lin Shuang does not need system reminder.She has seen too many things - the companions who fell in love with the half-filled bottle of water in the ruins, and the rescued people who snatched her backpack during the rescue.Trust is a luxury, and now she is reluctant to waste even a bottle of clean water.

"You said you were a medical student." Lin Shuang said in a straight tone without any emotion, "Which school? How many years have you studied? Do you have any clinical experience?"

Su Lin put down the kettle, raised her hand to wipe the water stains from the corners of her mouth with her sleeves, her distracted eyes slowly gathered together, as if she was salvaging a distant old time.

"Tongji Medical University, enrolling in 2030, five-year system. When the war breaks out in 2035, it will be the second semester of senior year, three months before graduation. "

Her voice was low, with a hint of vicissitudes of life, "After the school was bombed, I fled into the ruins with my classmates and wandered for three years. I have done daily debridement, wound sutures, and fracture fixation. Common infections, diarrhea, and mild radiation sickness have been common. I have also dealt with many survivor cases."

"Do you have a practicing certificate?"

Su Lin was stunned for a moment, then smiled bitterly: "In this troubled world, is a certificate still meaningful?"

“The certificate is an endorsement of the old world, what I want is the ability of the new world.”

Lin Shuang held the stone ax in her right hand flat in front of her knees, and pulled out the broken-tip dagger from her waist with her left hand, pointing the blade inward, and handed the handle to Su Lin.

"Help me look at the wound on your left arm. If you dare to turn the blade, I'll chop your wrist." The diagnosis is accurate and the treatment plan is reasonable. You can stay.If it is just a waste of time, it will leave on its own at dawn."

Su Lin stared at the blade, her pupils narrowed, but she did not retreat.

“You didn’t even think about killing me.Her tone suddenly became determined, "If you wanted to take action, you would have already taken action when I was drinking water without any precautions.""

“Help me look at the wound on my left arm.Lin Shuang said calmly, "The diagnosis is accurate and the treatment plan is reasonable. You can stay."If it is just a waste of time, it will leave on its own at dawn."

Su Lin took the dagger and subconsciously rubbed her fingertips on the hem of her sweater - it was stained with rust and gravel from the entrance.

This subtle move made Lin Shuang nod secretly in his heart.It's not how clean it is, but the very act of wiping - it shows that she knows that her hands must be clean before touching the wound, even if the conditions are limited, she can only make do.With this string, it is not a wild path.

“Let me look at the wound."

Lin Shuang slowly untied the cloth wrapped around his left arm.

The basement was dark and dark, with only a grayish-white light leaking through the crack at the entrance.Su Lin leaned closer, gently pressed the red and swollen flesh around the wound with her fingertips, lowered her head and sniffed the smell, her brows suddenly tightened.

Su Lin leaned closer, gently pressed the red and swollen flesh around the wound with her fingertips, lowered her head and sniffed the smell, her brows suddenly tightened.

"Have you dealt with it?Cleaned with soapy water and scraped off dead tissue?"

Lin Shuang nodded.

“It was done right, but not enough.Su Lin pointed to the dark red circle around the edge of the wound, "The necrotic tissue has not been scraped off, the abscess cavity has not been opened, and bacteria are multiplying in the deep layers.If it is delayed for another twenty-four hours, the infection will enter the bloodstream and it will be impossible for gods to save him.I have to debridement again now, can you bear it?"

“You have antibiotics?"

Su Lin shook her head gently: "I ran away all night and didn't have time to bring anything out.But on the way to being escorted, I pretended to be unconscious and glanced at two guards at the door of the medical tent. I heard them tell the time during the shift change.There is a medicine box in the tent with a green cross mark, piled on the left side of the entrance."

“You want me to force my way into the raider camp?"

“Not now."Su Lin shook her head, "When your wounds stabilize, we can stock up on weapons, understand the terrain, and then wait for our move."

The two looked at each other, testing each other silently.

Su Lin tested Lin Shuang to see if she was worthy of being entrusted to her, and Lin Shuang tested whether she really had the ability or was just talking.

“Three rules, established now."Lin Shuang took the dagger back, but didn't turn it back to his waist. "First, listen to my arrangements; second, manage the supplies; third, expel the traitors.If you agree, stay, if you disagree, leave now."

"I promise."

“Materials are under unified management, and no one is allowed to hide public property privately.Before allocation, all the funds will be shared by the public.Personal items - photos, keepsakes - should be kept by yourself and do not occupy public shares."

"Can."

“If new people join in the future, the same rules will apply.Once someone betrays me, I will handle it personally."

Su Lin was silent for a moment and asked softly: "What method of handling...are you talking about?"

Lin Shuang didn’t reply. She held the thumb of the stone ax and patted the ax handle twice slowly.

The silent movements reveal cold determination.

Su Lin understood instantly and didn’t dare to ask any more questions.
